name: HCI Group, Inc.
reason: Florida homeowners insurer whose earnings swing with hurricane losses and reinsurance pricing; 2025 EPS of 22.72 is 1.0x the 10y peak (vs ~3 historically) and consensus sees FY1 -7.9%, so current earnings are a cat-light peak.

name: National Vision Holdings, Inc.
reason: Discount optical retailer with EBIT margin 3.1% (10y avg 4.6%), 10y ROIC 1.7%, net debt/EBITDA 4.3x and EPS at 0.54x its 10y max; no durable economics.

name: Nexteer Automotive Group Limited
reason: Cyclical auto steering supplier whose EBIT margin collapsed from 11.5% to 3.9% and EPS is 0.27x its 10y peak (10y EPS CAGR -6.5%); OEM pricing power and EV/China exposure make it unforecastable.

name: Northwest Bancshares, Inc.
reason: Ordinary thrift with 10y EPS CAGR 5.9%, ROE 7.5% and acquisition-led growth (acq/FCF 1.03x, shares +3.7%/yr); a bargain without specialness.

name: JBT Marel Corp.
reason: Transformed by the 2025 Marel merger (acq/FCF 2.7x, shares +5.7%/yr, net debt/EBITDA 3.0x); integration makes the next 5-10 years hard to forecast despite decent food-equipment niches.

name: Science Applications International Corp.
reason: Single-customer US government IT contractor with thin 7.2% margins at a 10y high, net debt/EBITDA 3.75x, and consensus FY1 EPS +0.6% / LTG 5% amid federal spending and AI-driven IT services pressure.

name: Primerica, Inc.
reason: Dominant middle-market term-life distribution franchise with 10y EPS CAGR 19.9%, EPS up in 9/10 years, shares shrinking 4.3%/yr, ROE ~25% and consensus 8-10% growth; predictable in-force book economics.

name: OneMain Holdings, Inc.
reason: Non-prime consumer lender whose earnings are set by the credit cycle (EPS fell from 10.81 in 2021 to 4.89 in 2024; net debt/EBITDA 4.6x).

name: Gaming & Leisure Properties, Inc.
reason: Casino triple-net REIT growing via equity issuance (shares +9%/yr) with 5y FFO/share CAGR 2.4%, net debt/EBITDA 4.9x and concentrated tenants (PENN/BYD); no route to 7% per-share growth.

name: Shift4 Payments, Inc.
reason: Payments growth heavily acquisition-funded (acq/FCF 3.4x, Global Blue), net debt/EBITDA 3.9x, adjusted EPS 135% above GAAP and founder-CEO transition; too hard to forecast in a competitive, disrupting space.

name: NMI Holdings, Inc.
reason: Mortgage insurer whose earnings depend on the housing/credit cycle and benign loss reserves; EPS at 10y peak while consensus LTG is only 5.8% and FY2-3 growth 3-4%.

name: V2X Inc
reason: Low-margin (4.3% EBIT) government logistics contractor whose growth came via the Vectrus-Vertex merger (shares +11.4%/yr) with adjusted EPS 146% above GAAP; no specialness.

name: FS KKR Capital Corp.
reason: Externally managed BDC whose income is set by credit spreads and base rates; EPS fell from 4.40 to 2.34 over 10y, shares +16.6%/yr, leverage 12.8x and consensus FY1 -30.7%.

name: Samsonite Group SA
reason: Travel-cyclical luggage brand with 10y EPS CAGR 3.2%, EPS 0.78x its peak, a 2020 wipe-out and consensus LTG 1.9%; branded but no route to 7%+ growth.

name: Live Oak Bancshares, Inc.
reason: SBA small-business lender with highly volatile EPS (0.44-3.70, currently 0.5x 10y max) driven by loan-sale gains, credit losses and fintech marks; hard to forecast through a credit cycle.

name: Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings
reason: 2025 IPO E&S insurer with only three years of results (EPS 0.21 to 1.60) during a hard specialty market; no underwriting record across a soft cycle to judge.

name: Almonty Industries, Inc.
reason: Loss-making tungsten miner (EBIT margin -89.9%, shares +19.7%/yr) whose value hinges on commodity prices and Sangdong mine ramp-up.

name: Fidelity National Financial, Inc.
reason: Title oligopoly leader but earnings swing with housing transaction volumes and rates (EPS 7.32 in 2021 to 3.42 in 2023, now 0.68x peak) plus F&G annuity spread exposure.

name: ServisFirst Bancshares, Inc.
reason: Purely organic, highly efficient commercial bank with 10y EPS CAGR 15.6%, EPS up in 8/10 years, ROE ~18%, no acquisitions and flat share count; conservative underwriting and branch-light model support 7%+ growth.

name: Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
reason: Complex-generic/insulin maker facing generic price erosion and product-specific competition (glucagon, epinephrine); consensus LTG -5.2% and FY1 -8.6% after EPS peaked in 2024.
